input: When have you worked towards an ambitious goal? As part of your answer, please describe how you tackled this goal, what set backs you faced and what energised you about the situation. (500 words)
output:
An ambitious goal I pursued was building an adventure video game entirely from scratch. From a young age I had been drawn to storytelling and immersive game worlds, and I wanted to create something that was not only entertaining but emotionally engaging—through detailed character development and narratives that shifted with player choices.

I had no formal training in game or software design, so the project demanded deliberate self-teaching. The design I had in mind involved a richly detailed world and many interactive characters whose choices would meaningfully alter the storyline. That meant learning programming languages, game-development frameworks, and graphic design on my own. I structured the work carefully: online tutorials, webinars, and developer forums, broken into clear milestones so I could build a reliable foundation in programming and design principles rather than improvising.

Setbacks were significant. During testing of complex character interactions, frame rate fell sharply, producing lag that damaged the player experience. Preserving the game's rich content while restoring performance was essential. I studied optimisation methods and applied object pooling to manage resources, level-of-detail adjustments to ease processing load, and code refinement to remove unnecessary calculations. Those steps raised frame rate by roughly 30% and made complex interactions feel far smoother.

A second obstacle was integrating Python scripts for advanced computational tasks while Unity primarily uses C+. Misaligned data types caused real-time errors. I researched and built a middleware layer that standardised data types between Python and Unity, enabling efficient transfer and processing. Compatibility improved and overall performance benefited as well.

What energised me was visible progress. Each optimisation or narrative improvement made the next challenge feel manageable. Working with other developers in online communities such as Discord supplied practical insight and a sense of shared purpose during difficult phases. Releasing a demo was a major milestone: positive player feedback on seamless character interactions and engaging gameplay confirmed that the long hours had been worthwhile.

The project strengthened independent learning, adaptability, and resilience, and increased my confidence in ambitious goals without formal instruction. I want to bring those qualities to Eversheds, where independent learning and creative problem-solving can support practical, tailored solutions for clients.
